provenance: Role labels supplied by the portfolio owner; responsibilities grounded in the current resume and the owner's update request. No numerical employment outcomes have been supplied. Independent project metrics are not employment results.

roles.title: Product & AI Quality Operations Analyst
roles.relationship: Client assignment; not direct Apple employment.
bullets: Evaluate ML and GenAI pipeline outputs against policy and quality rubrics; troubleshoot edge cases and systematic failure patterns.
Research and validate geospatial and transit records; reconcile conflicting sources and verify structured data against APIs.
Build Python and SQL QA/QC checks and Power BI operational reports to streamline investigations and reduce operational escalations.
Use LLM-assisted analysis and prompt engineering to classify cases and extract operational signals; validate findings against source records.
Document root-cause findings and workflow requirements with cross-functional partners; support quality reviews and training to improve operational consistency.

roles.title: Business / Operations Analyst
bullets: Automate recurring reporting with Python and SQL ETL pipelines and Power BI/Excel KPI dashboards, reducing manual reporting effort.
Translate stakeholder business requirements into relational data models, KPI definitions and analytics workflows aligned with operational goals.
Build and evaluate forecasting and classification models to support planning; analyze operational and customer data in Python and SQL to surface decision-ready trends.
Validate transformed data and reporting outputs, document business processes, and collaborate with stakeholders on testing and process improvement.

roles.title: Data / Business Analyst
bullets: Build Python and SQL ETL workflows and Tableau dashboards to support customer acquisition, engagement and retention analysis.
Develop and evaluate segmentation and propensity (lead-scoring) models to inform marketing engagement analysis.
Maintain data validation rules and KPI definitions; test analytical outputs and translate cross-team business requirements into dependable reporting.
Document data-quality findings and reporting requirements with cross-functional partners to support consistent business decisions.

alignment: Transferable capabilities for Forward Deployed Engineering: translate stakeholder requirements into Python/SQL data workflows, investigate failures, automate repeatable analysis, and document and validate solutions against business needs. NASHA AI engineering projects are independent work, separate from professional employment.
summaries: Evaluate AI/ML and GenAI outputs, investigate data and model failures, and validate geospatial records against source data and APIs. Use Python, SQL, Power BI and LLM-assisted analysis for QA/QC, troubleshooting and reliable product operations.

Automate Python/SQL ETL and recurring reporting, build Power BI/Excel KPI dashboards, and develop forecasting models. Translate stakeholder requirements into validated analytics and process improvements that reduce manual reporting effort.

Build Python/SQL data pipelines and Tableau reporting for acquisition, engagement and retention. Evaluate segmentation and lead-scoring models, maintain validation rules, and translate cross-team requirements into tested analytical outputs.
